description: Canonical, business-level student object for bulk onboarding. Excel columns are mapped (later, by the LLM step) onto importFields; the deterministic validator (backend/src/validation/) checks them; the future LMS adapter translates them to LMS storage. Derived from a read-only inspection of the existing LMS (see config/README.md). Not a copy of any LMS table.

conventions.origin: 'import' = may come from Excel/LLM mapping. 'system' = never accepted from Excel/LLM; set by the authenticated admin context or the LMS adapter.
conventions.systemControlledFields: A canonical row containing any of these names or their aliases is rejected (FORBIDDEN_SYSTEM_FIELD). Names are compared ignoring case, '_' and '-', so university_id and universityId both match.
conventions.types: string = text (must be a JSON string). date = calendar date, must be a JSON string; canonical form YYYY-MM-DD.
conventions.normalization: trim = remove surrounding whitespace. emptyToNull = an empty value becomes null (optional fields only).
conventions.required: The value must be present and non-empty after normalization.
conventions.validation: Machine-readable rules read by the validator. Allowed keys: format ('email' | 'phone' | 'date'), allowedValues (array of strings), allowedValuesCaseInsensitive (boolean), errorCode (code used when allowedValues fails). Unknown keys are rejected when the schema is loaded.

formats.email: Basic syntax: local@domain.tld with no whitespace, exactly one '@', and non-empty dot-separated domain labels (decision OD-2).
formats.phone: International / E.164-compatible (decision OD-3): after removing spaces, hyphens, dots and parentheses, an optional leading '+' followed by 7 to 15 digits; when '+' is present the first digit must not be 0. Not country-specific. The value is kept as written (trimmed), never reformatted.
formats.date: Decision OD-4: accepts YYYY-MM-DD, or the ISO timestamp at midnight UTC that the Excel import produces for real Excel date cells (YYYY-MM-DDT00:00:00.000Z). Normalized to YYYY-MM-DD. Numeric day/month/year text such as 03/04/2010 is reported as AMBIGUOUS_DATE and never guessed, with one exception: when a date column of the uploaded sheet proves a day-first order (a 4-digit-year value whose first part is above 12, and none whose second part is above 12), that column is read as DD-MM-YYYY. Anything else is INVALID_DATE.

conventions.mappingHints: Non-binding example column names for the future LLM mapping prompt. The deterministic validator never uses them to reinterpret columns.
conventions.lms.persisted: Whether the current LMS create-student flow actually stores the value. false = accepted by the LMS API/UI but discarded today.
conventions.evidence: Paths are relative to the LMS root (the folder containing client/ and server/).

fullName.description: The student's full name as written. Kept as one value; never split into first/last name.
evidence: server/controllers/adminController.js createStudent: rejects the request unless fullName and email are present
client/src/pages/admin/AddStudent.jsx: blocks save unless fullName and email are filled
server/config/sqlite-db.js: users.name TEXT NOT NULL

email.description: The student's email address. Used as the LMS login identity and as the target for future onboarding emails. Kept as written (trimmed); compared ignoring case.
evidence: server/controllers/adminController.js createStudent: required; rejects if a user with the same email exists ("Student already exists")
server/config/sqlite-db.js and server/database/postgres-schema.sql: users.email UNIQUE NOT NULL
server/models/User.js (Mongoose): email required, unique, lowercase

className.description: Human-readable class/grade as written in the file (e.g. "10"). Input for classroom assignment only; never an LMS classroom ID.

lms.storage: students.grade (TEXT); classrooms are matched on classrooms.grade

evidence: server/controllers/adminController.js createStudent: stores className into students.grade
server/config/sqlite-db.js: classrooms.grade TEXT NOT NULL
server/controllers/classroomController.js createClassroom: grade is required

section.description: Human-readable section as written in the file (e.g. "A"). Input for classroom assignment only.

lms.storage: CONFLICT: createStudent writes section into students.rollNumber; classrooms.section holds the classroom's section

evidence: server/controllers/adminController.js createStudent: INSERT ... rollNumber = section
server/config/sqlite-db.js: classrooms.section TEXT
server/controllers/classroomController.js createClassroom: section is required

evidence: Accepted by createStudent and the AddStudent form (plain text input, no format rule), but not written to any table

AddStudent form uses <input type="date">; accepted by createStudent but not written to any table

bloodGroup.description: Blood group. One of the 8 standard values (decision OD-5); matched ignoring case and stored in the standard spelling.
evidence: Accepted by createStudent and the AddStudent form (free text), but not written to any table
Accepted by createStudent and the AddStudent form, but not written to any table

id.reason: Database primary key (users.id), assigned by the database.

password.reason: Generated by the LMS during creation (random, then bcrypt-hashed). Never taken from Excel/LLM.

role.reason: Fixed by the create-student flow. Never taken from Excel/LLM.

isApproved.reason: Admin-created students are stored with isApproved = 1.

universityId.reason: Tenant identity (users.university_id); comes from the authenticated admin's token.

studentId.reason: Generated by the LMS ("2026" + 6 random digits, students.studentId UNIQUE). Roll/admission numbers stay excluded (decision OD-6).

classroomId.reason: Internal classroom ID (student_classroom_assignment.classroomId, users.classroom_id). Resolved by the LMS adapter from className + section; never invented by the LLM.

fees.reason: Financial fields initialised to 0 by the LMS (students.totalFees, feesPaid, pendingFees); out of scope for onboarding.

subscriptionPlan.reason: Billing/tenant setting on users; not student data.

status.reason: Account status (users.status in PostgreSQL schema); lifecycle is owned by the LMS.

createdAt.reason: Timestamps are set by the database.

updatedAt.reason: Timestamps are set by the database.

classroomAssignment.appliesIn: LMS adapter (not the deterministic validator: it needs the target LMS's classrooms)
classroomAssignment.description: The import carries only human-readable className and section. The LMS adapter will resolve them to a classroom in the admin's university by trimmed, case-insensitive exact match on classrooms.grade / classrooms.section (decision OD-7). Zero or several matches are reported, never guessed.
evidence: server/controllers/classroomController.js assignStudentToClassroom: by classroomId + studentId, classroom must belong to the admin's university
server/routes/universalRoutes.js POST /classrooms/assign-student: also sets users.classroom_id
server/controllers/classroomController.js createClassroom: name is generated as "Grade <grade> - <section>"; no uniqueness check on grade + section

duplicateDetection.behaviour: Every row sharing a unique value is flagged; no row is dropped, merged or treated as an update.
duplicateDetection.existingLmsRecords: Not checked by the validator. Checking against existing LMS users is the LMS adapter's job (the current LMS rejects an existing email).

decisions.decision: Duplicate detection compares emails ignoring case. The original value is kept.
decisions.evidence: SQLite duplicate check uses exact 'email = ?' (case-sensitive); the Mongoose User model lowercases emails.

decisions.decision: Validate basic email syntax, even though the current LMS does not.
decisions.evidence: No format validation in createStudent or AddStudent.jsx (plain text input).

decisions.decision: International / E.164-compatible values; not country-specific. See conventions.formats.phone.
decisions.evidence: Phone is free text in the form and is not stored by the LMS.

decisions.decision: Accept real Excel date values and YYYY-MM-DD. Ambiguous numeric text dates (DD/MM vs MM/DD) are flagged, never guessed. No future-date or age rules.
decisions.evidence: The LMS form only produces YYYY-MM-DD; the fields are not stored.

decisions.decision: One of A+, A-, B+, B-, AB+, AB-, O+, O-.
decisions.evidence: Free text in the form; not stored.
students.rollNumber exists but createStudent fills it with section; students.studentId is auto-generated. No form field exists for either.

decisions.decision: Case-insensitive exact match of className + section; zero or multiple matches are reported, never guessed.
decisions.evidence: classrooms has grade + section per university with no uniqueness constraint; className values in students.grade are free text.

decisions.decision: Keep parentName, phone, dob, admissionDate, bloodGroup and address as optional canonical fields.
